entities.name: Muerra
entities.description: A legendary raccoonfolk warrior from Bloomburrow, leader of a throng of raccoonfolk who protect Scratchbark.

entities.name: Raccoonfolk
entities.description: Muerra's devoted throng who value survival second only to winning.

entities.name: Scratchbark
entities.description: Region leading to the Root Maze that Muerra's warriors roam and protect.

entities.name: Sunspine Lynx
entities.description: A creature Muerra tricked into attacking itself with light magic.

events.summary: Muerra and her throng roam and protect Scratchbark, fighting raiders and rescuing travelers.
events.quote: fighting raiders for fun and rescuing naïve travelers in exchange for materials

events.summary: Muerra uses light magic to make a Sunspine Lynx attack itself, one of her famous tales.
events.quote: she used light magic to cause a Sunspine Lynx to attack itself

relations.quote: Muerra is the fearsome leader of a small throng of devoted raccoonfolk
